code='''def transform(grid):
    """Copy the non-background pattern in the middle tile to both outer tiles."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separators = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h))]
    if len(separators) != 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    left, right = separators
    tile_width = min(left, w - right - 1)

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    horizontal = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 3 for v in grid[r])]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h))]
    row_edges = [-1] + horizontal + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + vertical + [w]
    row_tiles = [(row_edges[i] + 1, row_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_edges) - 1)]
    col_tiles = [(col_edges[i] + 1, col_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_edges) - 1)]
    tiles = []
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_tiles):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_tiles):
            cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] != 7]
            if cells:
                tiles.append((len(cells), ri, ci, cells, r1-r0, c1-c0))
    if not tiles:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _, src_ri, src_ci, cells, tile_h, tile_w = max(tiles, key=lambda x: x[0])
    src_r0, src_c0 = row_tiles[src_ri][0], col_tiles[src_ci][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_tiles):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_tiles):
            if (ri, ci) == (src_ri, src_ci):
                continue
            for r, c, value in cells:
                rr, cc = r0 + (r-src_r0), c0 + (c-src_c0)
                if rr < r1 and cc < c1:
                    out[rr][cc] = value
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',p); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demo_in=[[7,7,3,7,7],[7,7,3,7,7],[7,7,3,7,7],[7,7,3,7,7],[7,7,3,7,7],[7,7,3,7,7],[3,3,3,3,3],[7,7,3,7,7],[7,7,3,7,7],[7,7,3,7,7],[7,7,3,7,7],[7,7,3,7,7],[7,7,3,7,7],[3,3,3,3,3],[7,7,3,7,8],[7,7,3,7,7],[7,7,3,7,7],[7,7,3,7,7],[7,7,3,7,8],[7,7,3,7,8]]
